bit_exact.details: All E variants (E1, E2, E3) produce bit-identical results to V0 across all 256 iq3xxs_grid entries (via sweep_shift 0-3) and 6 random seeds, for both unfused (ffn_down) and fused (ffn_gateup) cases.

sass_chain_depth.details: SASS confirms: V0 has 8-deep v_dot4_i32_iu8 chain (all feed v1). E1 has 4 independent chains of depth 2. E2 and E3 have 8 independent dp4a operations (depth 1).

verdict_details: E variants break the 8-deep v_dot4 chain (confirmed in SASS) and are bit-exact, but show only marginal performance improvement (~0.3-0.7% on ffn_down, ~0.5% on ffn_gateup for E1). E2/E3 show slight regression on ffn_gateup due to increased register usage (35-37 vs 33). The dp4a chain is NOT the primary bottleneck; the kernel remains memory-latency bound.
recommendation: Do NOT adopt E variants. The marginal improvement does not justify the code complexity. The 8-deep v_dot4 chain is not the limiting factor for this memory-bound kernel.
